title: Threshold Kinetic Energy
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the expression for the threshold kinetic energy T_K.

title: Invariant Mass Condition
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of the invariant mass condition S = (E_K + m_p)^2 - p_K^2 = (m_Ω + 2m_K)^2.

title: Energy Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply energy conservation principles to relate the energies of the particles involved.

title: Maximum Angle Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must find the maximum angle theta_1 that the pions can make with the K^0 line of flight.

title: Lorentz Transformation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply Lorentz transformations to relate the momenta and energies of the pions in different frames.

title: Final Answer Format
description: Optional Criteria: The student should express final answers clearly and in the correct format, including units where applicable.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of relativistic equations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
